_about: The quick way to fire a hack without the command deck (Ross, Decision 1: a Kingdom Hearts style menu plus shortcuts). Keys 1 to 4 fire hack 1 to 4 straight away (hacks.json selection.order: Zap Drone, EMP, Overclock, Reboot). Holding a modifier button and pressing a face button fires the same four: the face button does not do its usual job while a modifier is held. Slots are 0-based positions in the order. Owner: Combat Designer (the mapping), Combat Programmer (the code). Remap by editing this file.
_modifiers_note: parry = the guard button (L on the keyboard, left shoulder on a pad). lock_on = Tab / middle mouse / right shoulder. Holding the lock-on button still toggles the lock when pressed, so the guard button is the cleaner one.
_buttons_note: Pad A (jump) = 1, B (dash) = 2, X (light) = 3, Y (heavy) = 4; on the keyboard Space, Shift, J, K.
